evidence.claim: The SEC-filed Q2 2026 issuer exhibit confirms approximately 16% worldwide procedure growth, USD 2.89 billion of quarterly revenue, expanding installed bases and recurring instrument revenue, USD 972 million of GAAP operating income, and USD 8.63 billion of cash, cash equivalents, and investments. These operating observations support a direct positive relationship between healthcare procedure automation and Intuitive's economics.

The issuer release independently records Q2 procedure and installed-base growth, expanding recurring instrument revenue, first-half GAAP earnings, strong liquidity, and tariff-sensitive guidance, corroborating the operating mechanism while preserving its cost and margin conditions.

The current security assessment reports only 2.5% base-case upside at the validated 2026-07-27 mark versus the configured 20% margin-of-safety target, with a 23.2% downside case, so the accepted causal edge does not justify strategy research or a signal.
